title: Chance across families
summary: Explore patterns without predicting a child.

cards.title: Meet the next 100 families
body: Each shape represents a different fictional family with one pregnancy. These are not children from one family.
This fixed model starts with two carriers of changes in the same recessive gene.
Runs vary around the model pattern. A run does not predict any family.

cards.title: One pregnancy at a time
body: Previous results do not change the next chance.
A short history can look uneven. The model stays the same for each new draw.
